negative_knowledge: Topological degree of normalized two-component field requires nonzero total local density; GP permits density zeros at finite energy.
Keeping both Noether species populations and fixed spatial boundary does not by itself force topological sectors to be disconnected.
Conserved GP energy is a separate constraint; the constructed path is NOT a GP dynamical orbit or proof of a decay rate.
Derrick shrinkage lowers homogeneous GP gradient energy but violates fixed N1, so that argument alone is insufficient under population conservation.
Skyrme quartic energy controls size within strict S2, but does not forbid full-target density zeros or octonionic S15 excursions.
Real trapped two-component skyrmions can be stabilized by phase separation, population constraints, rotation, and trap parameters; our symmetric homogeneous comparison does not contradict this.
Bosonic condensate species charges are not the original BFSS fermionic Fock CAR parity, operator star-action, or SU2 color gauge.
